text:
ana: Quick idea — pilot a PTO donation program (one-time caregiver top-up) for folks returning from extended parental leave. Wanted to surface any blocking policy/tax/payroll items before I draft a formal proposal.

devin: +1. From payroll side we need clarity on how this is paid out (regular PTO vs stipend) and the payroll code. Also need payroll cutoff lead times.

sarah: Prefer a leave-sharing model (donated hours converted to recipient PTO). If we go stipend, benefits + taxes are trickier. We should set eligibility window (e.g., within 6 months of leave return).

mike: Manager perspective — how do we avoid gaming? Recommend manager sign-off + HR review and a cap per recipient.

ana: (typo) ana: Proposed rules to start the discussion: max 40 donated hours received per person; donors must donate in 4-hour increments; donation window open for 30 days after program launch; manager sign-off required for recipients. Any obvious gaps?

devin: Payroll mechanics: easiest implementation is to treat donations as "special PTO top-up" paid through payroll as regular hours (taxed normally). If you want non-taxable treatment, legal needs to confirm and likely we'd need a different benefits vehicle. Also need sample expected volumes to size the implementation work.

sarah: Agreed. Suggest we call it "PTO donation (caregiver top-up)" so it's clear. I'll draft policy language that maps to existing PTO policy and adds eligibility + donation rules.

lina: lina (Legal): Quick note — treatment varies by jurisdiction. In the US, some leave-sharing programs can be structured to preserve tax treatment, but it's nuanced state-by-state. We should schedule a 30-min sync before we finalize wording.

mike: Also consider equitable access — managers shouldn't be pressured to donate. Maybe make donors opt-in with an anonymous pool.

devin: For payroll I need: 1) expected number of recipients, 2) payroll cycle mapping (which pay date), 3) GL account for donated PTO payout. I can draft a requirements template if someone fills in estimates.

sarah: I'll draft the policy + an FAQ for managers and donors. Will include eligibility table (parental leave types covered, timeframe) and sample donor/recipient flows.

hr-bot: hr-bot: Draft policy template created: /docs/hr/policy-template.md — use this for the pilot doc.

ana: ana: Thanks everyone. Action items: sarah to draft policy + FAQ by Fri EOD; devin to produce payroll requirements template by Mon; lina to set up a 30-min legal consult next week. mike will draft the manager-facing guidance. I'll compile and send out a one-pager for Exec review. :thumbsup:

mike: :raised_hands: Happy to help review the one-pager when ready.

devin: I'll also attach a sample CSV layout for payroll when I create the requirements doc. Example (for discussion):

```
employee_id,recipient_or_donor,hours,effective_pay_period,notes
12345,donor,8,2026-03-31,donation to pool
67890,recipient,8,2026-03-31,top-up payout
```

sarah: Perfect — that CSV shape should be fine. I'll include a short form for managers to approve recipients.

ana: Great. I'll schedule a follow-up thread once the drafts are in. Thanks all! :sparkles:
